jobs.description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work. In this role, you will: Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software. jobs.title: Elektriker (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an! Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft. Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage. Über uns Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen. Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist. Unsere Technology Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiter

We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. AI-Native by Default: We work heavily with Claude Code and other AI tools and expect everyone to use them fluently. Mit mehr als 2.000 Consultants, Data Scientists und Engineers in 26 Ländern arbeiten wir mit den globalen Marktführern zusammen. An unseren deutschen Standorten befinden wir uns auf einem rasanten Wachstumskurs. Wir beraten führende nationale und internationale Kunden branchenübergreifend dabei, das volle Potenzial ihrer Daten auszuschöpfen, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen aufzubauen und innovative KI-Lösungen zu implementieren. Als Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data & AI Strategy stehst du im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission. Du lieferst nicht nur statische Präsentationen, sondern schlägst die Brücke zwischen technologischen Möglichkeiten und geschäftlichen Anforderungen. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von fokussierten Kurzzeit-Projekten im gehobenen Mittelstand bis hin zu mehrphasigen KI-Transformationen in Großkonzernen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für crossfunktionale Workstreams, treibst datenbasierte Entscheidungen voran und gestaltest die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mit.   Das erwartet dich bei uns: Kundenberatung & Strategie: Du arbeitest eng mit (internationalen) Kunden zusammen, verstehst deren geschäftliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in datengestützte Empfehlungen, die strategische Entscheidungen und die Business Transformation unterstützen. Daten & Analyse: Du sammelst, strukturierst und bereitest Daten für Analysen auf. jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments. What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare. This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth. The Role We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession. You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes. This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Intern
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. We're more than just a website builder. You'll also shape where this goes next. jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description: We’re on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering. We’ve already protected over 3 million people through life’s big transactions. Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering. Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud. Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking. Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over \$33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems , owning technical direction within a domain, and helping other engineers grow through mentorship and example. jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in France. Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description: Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments? Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI? Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution? If your answers are yes, we should talk. At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the role At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth. As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. jobs.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models

jobs.title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
jobs.description: About the role Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it. This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants. At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it. What You'll Do Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on. Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description: Functie Reliability engineer Beschrijving functie De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets. De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden. De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken. Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout Taken Trouble shooting Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen Daily problem solving Continue verbeteren Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers

Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans! jobs.title: Senior Visual Designer
jobs.description: At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries. How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Senior Visual Designer, you'll take our visual identity and our website to the next level, and help build a brand that matches our ambitions. Nothing is set in stone, and there's a lot we want to build. This is what you'll do Your work is often the first thing a hotel chain or a bakery sees of us, usually on a screen: our website, a campaign, a landing page. You'll shape how Dyflexis looks and feels everywhere and take the brand from consistent to unmistakable. You'll work closely with our Brand Designer, the Marketing team, and UX/UI colleagues. You bring creative ideas, design thinking and a strong eye for digital. You turn business goals into concepts, carry one strong idea through every touchpoint, and know how to win people over with your work. Take our visual identity further: typography, colour, imagery, illustration and motion, into a bold language that works in every market and language we're in. Bring dyflexis.com to the next level: layouts, landing pages and the visual side of the user journey, together with the Product team. Design campaigns, social, ads, landing pages and sales materials that are on brand and on point. You keep the brand sharp in the everyday work, and you make it better every time. Turn business goals into creative concepts and help shape where the brand goes next

jobs.title: Junior Tester
jobs.description: Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe software werkt en vind je het leuk om uit te zoeken of alles doet wat het zou moeten doen? Heb je oog voor detail, stel je graag kritische vragen en krijg je energie van het vinden van verbeterpunten? Dan is deze functie als Junior Tester precies wat je zoekt! Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen. Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken. Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester? Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen. Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert. Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden: Opstellen van testscenario's Uitvoeren van testgevallen Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. ABOUT ODYSSEY We're The Odyssey Hotel Group, Europe’s most ambitious hotel operator and the team behind many famous global hospitality names. We partner with Marriott, IHG, and Accor to develop exceptional properties across various brands, from Holiday Express to Marriott's Autograph collection. Powered by over 800 employees and supported by Activum SG as our major shareholder, our purpose is to shape hospitality together! ABOUT POSITION The Portfolio Commercial Director is responsible for the overall commercial performance of a blended portfolio of full service hotels, strongly MICE driven hotels in key markets in Germany. This role holds end-to-end accountability for commercial strategy and execution, covering Sales, Revenue Management, Distribution, and Marketing, with a strong focus on sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, and profitability, while ensuring alignment with owner expectations and long-term asset value creation. As a senior commercial leader, the role acts as a trusted advisor to hotel owners and asset managers, delivering transparent, data-driven insights and ensuring that all commercial strategies support both short-term performance and long-term financial returns. The position operates within a matrix organisation, partnering closely with Operations, Finance, and commercial discipline leaders to drive integrated commercial strategies across the portfolio. jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.   At Wolt, as a part of Doordash, we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery platform to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and courier partners.  What makes our team unique: Our global Security team aspires to be the world’s most admired security team, with members across EU, UK and North America (operating as Wolt, Deliveroo and Doordash). We’re shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our “classic” platforms of the three companies. The greater team is not just information security - we’re more holistic, and also physical security and safety are a part of our global operations.   This position is open in our Wolt hubs in Berlin, Germany , or Helsinki, Finland , and will be a part of the Global Security Engineering team.   Day-to-day in this role you’ll:   Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale. jobs.title: Senior Space Systems Engineer, Mission Optimization
jobs.description: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About the Role: The Mission Optimization team is responsible for continuously improving the operations and productivity of the world’s largest Earth observation satellite constellation. We identify, triage, and resolve the bottlenecks that limit what our fleets can deliver – from contact scheduling and downlink latency, to collection capacity, to concepts of operation for our future missions. As a Senior Space Systems Engineer on this team you will own the definition of novel concepts of operations. You will take problems that begin as a customer commitment, a contractual obligation, or an unexploited spacecraft capability, and turn them into an operational concept that engineering teams can build and operators can run. jobs.title: Data analyst - AML
jobs.description: About the team: At SumUp, keeping our platform safe and compliant is critical to the trust of the millions of small businesses we serve around the world. You’ll join our Global AML team at an exciting point in its growth. We’re expanding into new markets, evolving our AML capabilities, introducing AI-enabled controls, and navigating increasingly complex regulatory expectations. As an AML Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in turning AML data into actionable insights. Working closely with our global AML Operations and AML Governance teams, as well as colleagues across Engineering and Data, you’ll help us understand how our controls are performing, identify risks and gaps early, and make better decisions as our business scales. This is a role where your analysis will go beyond reporting. jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Suchst du eine Führungsrolle, in der deine positive Energie und dein Teamgeist den Unterschied machen? Bei Picnic suchen wir nicht nur jemanden, der Prozesse steuert, sondern eine Führungskraft, die ihr Team inspiriert und jeden Tag zu einem Erfolgserlebnis macht. Als Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d) bist du das Herzstück des täglichen Betriebs in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Viernheim . Du coachst, motivierst und unterstützt dein Team aus Shoppers, stellst sicher, dass sie sich wohlfühlen und gemeinsam Großes leisten. Dein Engagement ist entscheidend, um unsere Lagerabläufe reibungslos zu gestalten. Im engen Austausch mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung sorgst du dafür, dass wir als großes Team unsere täglichen Ziele erreichen. Das erwartet dich  Teamleitung:  Leite, motiviere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus 20+ Shoppers. Du bist ihre erste Ansprechperson, hast stets ein offenes Ohr und förderst ihre Entwicklung. Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung steuerst du proaktiv die Prozesse im FC. Du trägst maßgeblich zu einer positiven und unterstützenden Arbeitsatmosphäre bei. Tagesgeschäft: Stelle sicher, dass alle Einkäufe pünktlich, sicher und in bester Qualität das FC verlassen. Dabei bist du der Fels in der Brandung, der auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf bewahrt und Ruhe ausstrahlt. Prozessoptimierung: Bringe deine Ideen ein und verbessere gemeinsam mit dem Leadership stetig unsere Logistikprozesse. Du ermutigst dein Team, mitzudenken und sich aktiv einzubringen. jobs.title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurz und Knapp   Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen, und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik? Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einer Teamleitung für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in München. Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.   Das erwartet dich    Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken. Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft. Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort. Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”. Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich. Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können. Bringe deine Ideen ein : Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen könne

jobs.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Du hast dein Studium frisch in der Tasche, sprühst vor Tatendrang und willst nicht an der Seitenlinie stehen, sondern direkt das Steuer übernehmen? Bei uns steigst du nicht einfach nur ein – du übernimmst ab Tag 1 echte Führungsverantwortung. Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) bist du das pulsierende Herz unseres vollautomatisierten Fulfillment Centers (FC) in  Oberhausen . Zusammen mit Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation revolutionieren wir den Markt und bauen das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas. Das erwartet dich  Teamführung: Du bist Coach, Vorbild und Sparringspartner. Mit echter Empathie führst, inspirierst und entwickelst du dein Team aus 5 Teamleitenden und über 200 Lagermitarbeitenden. Schichtleitung: Bei dir laufen die Fäden zusammen. Du priorisierst im laufenden Betrieb, löst Engpässe direkt vor Ort und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich vom Band rollt. Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es nicht. Du blickst über den Tellerrand, zerlegst komplexe Logistikprozesse datenbasiert in ihre Einzelteile und hebst unsere Abläufe mit deinen eigenen Projekten aufs nächste Level. Abwechslung: Langeweile? Fehlanzeige. Du liebst die Dynamik aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3-4 Tage pro Woche) und konzeptioneller Deep Dive Arbeit im FC Office (1-2 Tage pro Woche). Stakeholdermanagement: Wenn der Betrieb kocht, läufst du zur Hochform auf. Du behältst selbst bei ungeplanten Spitzen einen kühlen Kopf, triffst souverän Entscheidungen und gibst deinem Team jederzeit Rückhalt. Das bringst du mit Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistik, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich. Erste praktische Einblicke in die Lager-, Logistik- oder Produktionswelt (z. B. durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten) und absolute Machermentalität. Ein großes Herz für Menschen: Du bist nahbar, kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisc

Ce que tu vas faire chez nous Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production. jobs.description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. jobs.title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build. The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job. You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Architecture above DATEV Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath. Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck. Make integration a capability, not a project:

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
jobs.description: The question Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. En tant que stagiaire Data Analyst, tu seras intégré(e) à une équipe travaillant étroitement avec des consultants / data scientists et tu participeras à des missions ayant un impact réel pour les clients. Tes missions pourront inclure : Collecter, nettoyer, préparer les données à partir de sources diverses (bases de données internes, API, logs, etc.). Explorer et analyser les données pour identifier tendances, anomalies, corrélations, patterns utiles. Participer à la conception et réalisation de dashboards / reportings sous outils de data visualisation (ex. Tableau, PowerBI, ou outils internes) pour présenter les résultats aux équipes ou aux clients. Contribuer à la définition de KPI pertinents selon les objectifs métier. Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes métier (marketing, produit, etc.) pour bien comprendre leurs besoins et transformer ces besoins en analyses exploitables. Aider à automatiser certains processus de reporting ou analyses simples. Documenter tes travaux, partager les résultats et les apprentissages au sein de l’équipe, proposer des améliorations ou de nouvelles approches quand c’est possible. Profil recherché

L’agence puise son inspiration dans le réel et les insights précis pour concevoir des idées qui résonnent et marquent les esprits sur tous les terrains de jeu créatifs, de l’IA aux médias intemporels.  Basée à Paris, Artefact 3000 compte 65 collaborateurs et accompagne ses clients dans la définition de leur stratégie de communication, la conception et le déploiement de campagnes intégrées, l’animation des réseaux sociaux, et la production digitale (contenus, expériences digitales, sites web). Production IA (cœur du poste) Produire des contenus image et vidéo avec des outils IA génératifs (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Higgsfield,, etc.) selon des briefs créatifs précis. Assurer la post-production et l intégration des assets IA dans des livrables finaux (montage, compositing, motion). Motion design & exécution créative Produire des contenus vidéo en motion design (After Effects, Premiere Pro). Décliner des concepts visuels validés sur les formats de campagne 360 (social, display, film digital, OOH). Contribuer à l élaboration de moodboards et key visuals en amont de production. PROFIL Expérience Diplômé(e) d une école de Design (design graphique ou motion design) ou avec une première expérience professionnelle en agence.  Un portfolio avec des productions IA concrètes est obligatoire ; les candidatures sans livrables IA ne seront pas examinées. Compétences techniques indispensables Maîtrise indispensable de la Suite Adobe : After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop et Illustrator

Nous accélérons désormais notre ambition : devenir le partenaire clinique de référence en Europe, de confiance pour les patients et les professionnels, grâce à la puissance de technologies avancées et de l'IA. Notre ambition est de construire le système d'exploitation clinique de demain pour l'Europe - offrant des résultats de santé mesurables pour des millions de personnes. Pour les professionnels de santé : Nous réduisons la charge administrative, augmentons la prise de décision clinique grâce à l'IA et permettons de nouveaux modèles de soins. Pour les patients : Nous passons de soins réactifs en cas de maladie à une gestion proactive de leur santé, en donnant aux personnes les moyens de prendre en charge leur santé avec des compagnons numériques de confiance, recommandés par les médecins. Vos missions L'hôpital est clé pour le développement de Doctolib. En une décennie, nous avons construit une présence solide auprès des établissements de santé, publics et privés à but non lucratif, avec une suite complète de solutions couvrant l'ensemble du parcours ambulatoire : visibilité de l'offre de soins, planification, prise de rendez-vous, préparation administrative, assistant de consultation IA, téléconsultation, téléexpertise et bien plus encore. En tant que Head of Hospitals & Home Care, vous prenez la tête d'une équipe d'une quinzaine de personnes, structurée en acquisition et account management, et appuyée par de nombreuses équipes expertes partenaires, notamment Déploiement, Interopérabilité, Product Marketing et Affaires Publiques. jobs.title: KYC/KYB Analyst
jobs.description: [OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here ). [OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. [OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. [AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. Join us as a KYC/KYB Analyst to protect Qonto's regulated growth while keeping onboarding fast and fair for our clients. You'll review enhanced due diligence and KYBC cases, decide who can safely open or keep a Qonto account, and flag financial-crime risks the moment you spot them, working closely with our Lead EDD. ➡️ What you'll do Decide on high-risk files: Review EDD cases for onboarding and lifecycle reviews, then approve, reject, or send them back to L1 for missing or invalid documents. Handle KYBC edge cases fast: Assess alternative documents and gray-activity requests, closing decisions within a 48-hour SLA when clients are blocked. Focus where it matters: Automation handles the routine files, so you'll concentrate your judgment on the riskiest ones during your weekly control checks. jobs.title: Senior Value Consultant - FSI
jobs.description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI s operational blind spots into operational clarity. World s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. (Internal Job Title: Senior Value Engineer) The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments. The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the FSI sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems. The work you’ll do: Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first

jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de l IA et de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises.  La mission des Artefactors ?
